scope: U2-U4a upstream contract gates, LSP/trace probes and weekly read-only check

contract_tests.note: real LSP and pinned trace processor ran; b017_model_analysis included

changes.codeboarding: optional analysis_schema_version; unknown major rejected before digest; tree_spec observed
changes.scip: Metadata.version must be 0; non-zero rejected; missing tool_info is a warning
changes.aoci: #Format-Version and #AOCI-ROOT-MANIFEST parsed; unknown major and missing headers are warnings
changes.traces: fixtures.lock.json hashes, sizes, producers, limitations and consuming tests audited
changes.lsp: serverInfo/capability probe with evidence-layer downgrade; sealed runtime profile unchanged
changes.trace_processor: checked wrapper fails closed on pinned version or sha256 mismatch
changes.u4a: status --out/--fail-on-update, URL/HEAD fallback, check --out, weekly workflow and evidence template

limitations: version and lockfile pins are not probed by the weekly check; U4b covers them
CodeBoarding has no analysis_schema_version in the pinned 0.15.3 artifact; the gate is optional by design
SCIP protocol v0.3 defines only version 0; the gate rejects any future non-zero value
trace artifacts have no common in-band version; the check audits the fixture lock instead
LSP capability downgrade is evidence-only; runtime promotion needs an ADR and a sealed-pack revision
the weekly workflow runs on the public snapshot default branch; the private tree uses local commands
